full_judgment: 2. Briefly the facts necessary for disposal of the Rule are that the petitioner is a business man and a regular tax payer of the country. He is the owner of a group of companies. The petitioner earlier in the year 1987 joined, in service at Titans Gas T&D Company as Meter Reader and had been placed as OSD in 1989 & in 1996 the petitioner had been terminated from service on the allegation of his involvement in other business; that thereafter the petitioner filed a suit labour Court wherefrom he got a decree in his favour in 2002 with full benefit; that thereafter the petitioner joined in service in March,2003 and on 25 June, 2003 the petitioner resigned from his service. Thus the petitioner was in active service only for a few months.
